description: This file is a test script for the Git version control system, specifically testing responses to protocol violations. It includes tests for handling malformed packets and protocol errors during upload-pack operations, verifying that Git behaves correctly under various invalid input scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting success with specified setup.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for patterns in output/error logs.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Generates a test object id based on algorithm.

methods.name: git rev-parse
methods.description: Outputs the object ID of the current revision.

methods.name: git ls-remote
methods.description: Lists references in a remote repository.
